<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/management/teams/{team_id}/drivers"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



FindDrivers handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve driver records associated with a specific team.
It expects the team Id as a URL parameter, validates it, and returns a paginated list of drivers
belonging to that team. Returns appropriate HTTP status codes and error messages for invalid
team Ids or if no drivers are found.
